messages:
maya: quick note from bringup: r3b-compact-int8 shows ndcg@10 -3.9% vs prod-ranker on the web-sampled harness, but mrr slightly higher. feels like a formatting mismatch + some long-doc truncation.
lucas: can you drop a couple of concrete queries/candidates?
maya: sure, pasted two examples. notice mixed caps and inline html.
```
Q: change email on account
cand1: "Go to https://example.com/account/edit or click Edit Email"
cand2: "Change email: Account -> Email settings"
```
nina: prod canonicalizer strips urls and lowercases. did you run the same pipeline?
maya: i ran eval-harness raw text (default). re-ran 500-sample with canonicalizer_v2 and ndcg recovered ~80% of gap.
lucas: numbers? round please.
maya: prod ctrl: ndcg@10=0.428, mrr=0.301. r3b-int8 raw: ndcg@10=0.411, mrr=0.305. r3b-int8 canonicalized: ndcg@10=0.423, mrr=0.303.
nina: ok formatting explains most delta. remaining ~0.005 ndcg could be kvpack truncation or candidate-order nondeterminism. add seqlen histogram and per-query rank-diff logging.
maya: queued CI job rerank-playground/1775551234-format-ablate with flags: --canonicalizer=canonicalizer_v2 --force-sort=prod --seqlen-hist --rank-diffs=top3. @ops-bot please run on web-sample-10k.
ops-bot: Job rerank-playground/1775551234-format-ablate queued on short executor. link: https://ci.internal/rerank/1775551234
lucas: also include a small fp16 vs int8 per-candidate score scatter output so we can see if quant shifts are localized to long html-heavy docs.
maya: added --scatter=f16_vs_i8 and --kvpack-toggle (on/off). plan: 1) confirm canonicalizer parity, 2) toggle kvpack, 3) if gap persists sample candidate score scatter + manual inspection.
nina: assigning lucas to scatter + rank-diffs, i'll check seqlen/truncation stats, maya to compile short triage note after CI finishes.
lucas: noted, will sketch a quick viz template.
ops-bot: CI job started (task 1/4).
